destinations.name: Vulcano Etna
destinations.desc_it: Crateri, colate laviche, grotte e pinete d'alta quota.
destinations.desc_en: Craters, lava flows, caves and high-altitude pine forests.

destinations.name: Parco dei Nebrodi
destinations.desc_it: Laghi montani, boschi secolari, cavalli selvaggi e maialini neri.
destinations.desc_en: Mountain lakes, ancient beech woods, wild horses and scenic peaks.

destinations.name: Valle dell'Alcantara & Castiglione
destinations.desc_it: Canyon di basalto colonnare, fiumi cristallini e borghi medievali.
destinations.desc_en: Prismatic basalt gorges, crystal waters and medieval wine hamlets.

destinations.name: Isole Eolie in Barca & E-Bike
destinations.desc_it: Lipari, Vulcano e Salina tra coste vulcaniche e mare turchese.
destinations.desc_en: Lipari, Vulcano and Salina with coastal trails and cobalt sea.

destinations.name: Val di Noto & Costa Barocca
destinations.desc_it: Scicli, Modica, Noto e le oasi marine protette tra muri a secco.
destinations.desc_en: UNESCO Baroque towns, stone walls and protected marine reserves.

bike_types.desc_it: Comfort e tenuta massima su sentieri sconnessi, discese e sterrati lavici.
bike_types.desc_en: Maximum comfort and traction on rough singletracks and lava gravel.

bike_types.desc_it: Leggera e scattante, perfetta per strade forestali e piste battute.
bike_types.desc_en: Lightweight and agile, ideal for smooth forest paths and gravel tracks.

bike_types.desc_it: Per chi ama il ritmo del cicloturismo veloce su asfalto e strade bianche.
bike_types.desc_en: For lovers of fast cycle-touring on paved country roads and packed gravel.

difficulty_levels.desc_it: Piste ciclabili e strade panoramiche con soste frequenti e zero stress.
difficulty_levels.desc_en: Panoramic quiet lanes with frequent stops, photo ops and zero stress.

difficulty_levels.desc_it: Sterrati facili, dislivelli collinari gestiti in scioltezza con il motore.
difficulty_levels.desc_en: Easy off-road, rolling hills easily conquered with motor assistance.

difficulty_levels.desc_it: Singletrack vulcanici tecnici, discese guidate e pendenze audaci.
difficulty_levels.desc_en: Technical volcanic singletracks, rocky trails and daring mountain climbs.

extra_experiences.desc_it: Sosta gourmet con sapori tradizionali autentici nei borghi.
extra_experiences.desc_en: Gourmet stop with authentic Sicilian flavors in historic villages.

extra_experiences.name_it: Degustazione Vini DOC Etna in Cantina Storica
extra_experiences.name_en: Etna DOC Wine Tasting at Historic Cellar
extra_experiences.desc_it: Visita ai vigneti d'alta quota e degustazione 3-4 calici con tagliere.
extra_experiences.desc_en: High-altitude vineyard tour and tasting of 3-4 wines with pairings.

extra_experiences.name_it: Notte in Dimora Tipica / Agriturismo con Colazione
extra_experiences.name_en: Overnight in Historic Country Estate / Agriturismo
extra_experiences.desc_it: Pernottamenti curati immersi nella natura siciliana.
extra_experiences.desc_en: Boutique stays nestled in Sicilian vineyards and nature reserves.

extra_experiences.name_it: Barca Privata per Traversate Isole Eolie
extra_experiences.name_en: Private Boat for Aeolian Island Crossings
extra_experiences.desc_it: Trasferimento e navigazione privata con trasporto bici a bordo.
extra_experiences.desc_en: Private skipper and transfers with bikes onboard.

extra_experiences.name_it: Furgone di Supporto al Seguito & Trasporto Bagagli
extra_experiences.desc_it: Zero pensieri: valigie trasferite da tappa a tappa e van sempre reperibile.
extra_experiences.desc_en: Stress-free: bags moved hotel-to-hotel and support vehicle always nearby.
